sources: Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting, Information 2026 (MDPI) — https://www.mdpi.com/2078-2489/17/1/56
Stacked Ensemble Model for NBA Prediction, Scientific Reports 2025 (Nature) — https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-13657-1
XGBoost + SHAP for NBA Game Outcomes, PMC NIH — https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11265715/
Best Data Points for 2026 NBA Predictions, SportBotAI

sota_benchmarks.note: No breakthrough TabNet/TabICL found. Gradient boosting dominance continues through 2026. We beat CNN (0.221). Gap to XGBoost SOTA: 0.018.

key_findings: Dynamic rolling-form ELO momentum (team_elo_rolling_5g, season momentum) consistently ranks top-3 predictive feature across all 2025-2026 published models — primary gap vs SOTA
Point differential denoising: team_point_diff_rolling_10g replaces raw W/L to reduce luck/clutch variance; published Brier gain 0.003-0.005
home_next scheduling feature (is next game home?) as proxy for rest/travel fatigue — simple but ranks top predictors in SportBotAI 2026 analysis
RNN + Monte Carlo dropout for calibrated uncertainty quantification — improves ECE without degrading Brier; relevant for TF agent calibration
XGBoost + SHAP integration: SHAP-guided feature selection removes 60-80% low-value features while preserving predictive power — aligns with MAX_FEATURES=200 constraint
Stacked ensembles (tree + sequential, Nature 2025): modest gains but high complexity cost; gradient boosting alone competitive for our use case

proposals.title: Add team ELO rolling momentum features to features/engine.py
proposals.description: team_elo_5g_momentum (rolling 5-game ELO delta), team_elo_season_momentum (season-to-date ELO trend slope), team_form_last_5 (W/L ratio last 5 games weighted by margin). Identified as top-3 predictive in LR SOTA (0.199). We may have base ELO but likely missing rolling momentum variants.
proposals.effort: low — 3 derived features in features/engine.py v3.1

proposals.title: Add point_differential_rolling denoising features
proposals.description: team_point_diff_rolling_10g (rolling 10-game avg point differential), team_point_diff_vs_spread_10g (actual PD minus spread expectation rolling). Reduces win/loss luck variance. Published gain: 0.003-0.005 Brier reduction.

proposals.title: Add scheduling fatigue features
proposals.description: home_next (next game is home/away), games_last_7d (back-to-back proxy), days_rest (days since last game). SportBotAI identifies these as top 2026 predictors.
proposals.effort: medium — requires schedule parsing from existing data

proposals.title: Add xgboost_brier objective to NBA island mutation pool
proposals.description: Political P2 reached all-time best 0.24997 using xgboost_brier objective (Brier/log-loss optimized XGBoost). Should be added to NBA island mutation pool immediately. Low risk — config change only, no engine modification.
proposals.cross_project_validation: POL P2 xgboost_brier 0.24997 (all-time best for P2) is definitive validation
proposals.effort: low — mutation pool config in island app.py

proposals.title: Add isotonic calibration to island GA eval loop
proposals.description: Post-hoc isotonic calibration already used in Colab TabICL run (0.22054 calibrated vs 0.22169 CV = 0.001 gain). Adding to island eval loop would optimize calibrated Brier throughout GA evolution. ECE improvement expected.
proposals.effort: medium — eval loop modification in HF Space app.py
